claims.claim: SAPLMA, a feedforward classifier on hidden-layer activations, labels statements true vs false with 71% to 83% average accuracy depending on the LLM base model.
claims.scope_conditions: OPT-6.7b and LLAMA2-7b, six-topic true-false dataset
claims.quoted_support: our trained classifier achieves an average of 71% to 83% accuracy labeling which sentences are true versus false, depending on the LLM base model.

claims.claim: Few-shot prompting reaches no more than 56% accuracy, versus 60-80% for SAPLMA on specific topics.
claims.quoted_support: SAPLMA reaches accuracy levels of between 60% to 80% on specific topics, while few-shot prompting achieves only slightly above random performance, with no more than a 56% accuracy level.

claims.claim: LLM-assigned sentence probability relates to truthfulness but depends on sentence length and word frequency.
claims.quoted_support: this probability is also dependent on sentence length and the frequencies of words in the sentence

claims.claim: SAPLMA with OPT-6.7b is best at the 20th of 32 layers; a random-label control yields 62.5% accuracy.
claims.quoted_support: The average accuracy on the random training data is only 62.5%.

breadth.confidence_families: Hidden-layer feedforward probe (SAPLMA); baselines BERT-embedding classifier, 3/5-shot prompting, 'It-is-true' sentence probability (Section 4-5).
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: Facebook OPT-6.7b and LLAMA2-7b, both 32 layers (Section 4); layers last, 28th, 24th, 20th, middle probed.
breadth.base_vs_instruct: not present (searched: instruct, chat); base pretrained LLMs.
breadth.post_training_stages: not present (searched: RLHF, SFT; only a classifier on frozen activations is trained)
breadth.elicitation_formats: Activations as LLM reads externally generated statements; also generated statements; few-shot prompting baseline (Section 4-5).
breadth.benchmarks: True-False dataset: Cities, Inventions, Chemical Elements, Animals, Companies, Scientific Facts (Section 3); no code.
breadth.label_source: Curated true/false labels from reliable sources; Scientific Facts created with ChatGPT (Section 3).
breadth.label_independence: Leave-one-topic-out: classifier trained on all other topics, tested on held-out topic; 3 random seeds (Section 4).

breadth.calibration_metrics: Accuracy only; no ECE or Brier (searched: ECE, Brier, calibration).
